findings.description: Oracle independence is asserted by category label, not demonstrated by construction. All three in-scope test measures declare oracle_basis 'source_grounded' and specify expected values such as cell_voltage_mv = 3300 with tolerance +/- 1.5 mV, but none states where that expected value came from or how it was derived independently of the implementation under test. 'source_grounded' names the provenance class of the oracle without supplying the derivation, so a reader cannot distinguish an independently derived datasheet-nominal value from a value read out of the implementation. The master prompt forbids using implementation output as a verification basis; this review cannot confirm compliance, because the information needed to confirm it is not in the records. This is a missing-documentation finding, not an allegation that any oracle is in fact self-referential. The same condition affects all five as_is test measures corpus-wide, including the two outside this record's scope.
findings.evidence: test_measure.schema.json defines oracle_basis as an enum of {source_grounded, analytical_model, synthetic_assumption, measured_reference} and defines no companion field for the derivation. FB2-VER-TMS-000003, -000004 and -000005 each carry the bare string 'source_grounded' with no derivation, reference anchor or method note. FB2-VER-TMS-000004 expected_outcomes: cell_voltage_mv expected '3300' tolerance '+/-1.5 mV', pec_error expected 'true'; neither cites a datasheet value, a calibration record or a design anchor.

findings.description: Clean result on expected-outcome measurability for the three in-scope test measures: every expected outcome names a concrete signal with an explicit expected value, a tolerance and a unit, and none is a tautological restatement of the test passing. This distinguishes the as_is measures from the five synthetic planning stubs, whose expected outcomes are single boolean signals that merely restate success - recorded separately as FB2-REV-FND-000144. Recorded as a performed check.
findings.evidence: FB2-VER-TMS-000003: plausibility_result expected 'pass' unit 'enum', flagged_cell expected 'true' unit 'bool'. FB2-VER-TMS-000004: cell_voltage_mv expected '3300' tolerance '+/-1.5 mV', pec_error expected 'true'. FB2-VER-TMS-000005: contactor_state expected 'on' unit 'enum', all_off expected 'true'. All carry tolerance and unit.

dispositions.action: Accepted. Adding an oracle-derivation field is a schema and authoring change outside this review's write scope. No test measure was edited. Referred to the verification owner: each expected value should cite the anchor or derivation it comes from so that independence is auditable rather than asserted.
No action required. Recorded as a verified-clean criterion.
